unresolvedRequirements: The current official KS X 6101:2024 CurveType schema defines hp:seg with a type and x1/y1/x2/y2 endpoints, but no editable Bezier control-point fields. The separate ConnectLineType controlPoints model is not a curve contract.
Bezier control-point editing therefore has no verified serialization representation in the supported HWPX contract. Do not synthesize undocumented attributes or child elements.

CURVE segment insertion/deletion remains unsupported because endpoint-only samples and the standard do not specify interpolation/control data needed to reproduce or split the curve safely. Any narrower LINE-only split/merge extension remains unimplemented and must preserve original segment metadata.

formatEvidence.source: Hancom HWPML 3.0 Revision 1.2, section 5.6.6, table 140 SEGMENT
formatEvidence.finding: The 2012 HWPML table defines only Line/Curve type and endpoint coordinates; this historical reference is not used as the sole evidence for the current format. It does not prove that proprietary extensions do not exist.

currentOfficialStandard.source: e나라표준인증 KS X 6101:2024 machine-readable standard, revision 03, active; operation date 2024-10-30; Annex E ParaList XML Schema, CurveType
currentOfficialStandard.schemaFinding: CurveType contains an unbounded sequence of seg elements. Each seg defines type (LINE or CURVE), x1, y1, x2, and y2 integer attributes only. It has no control-point attributes/elements or wildcard. ConnectLineType separately defines controlPoints/point; that applies to connectors, not CurveType.
currentOfficialStandard.conclusion: The supported current schema does not provide an editable Bezier control-point serialization contract. Keep those mutations fail-closed unless a compatible authentic extension/sample establishes one.

rhwpModelReview.finding: The parser builds a point chain from each hp:seg start/end pair and leaves the HWP5-specific segment_types field empty for HWPX. The writer emits endpoint hp:seg records from that chain. The geul partial edit path retains original hp:seg lexical metadata for supported endpoint edits; unknown source metadata/types are not promoted into a guessed control-point model.

sampleCorpusAudit.source: Repository RHWP sample corpus under external/rhwp/samples/**/*.hwpx; aggregate counts are observational and may include synthetic regression fixtures.
sampleCorpusAudit.conclusion: The inspected compatible examples agree with the current schema, but the sample corpus cannot prove that no proprietary extension exists anywhere.
